verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR and payroll platform, so PTO policy management is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence only says the API exposes 'time off' data. Nothing documents defining PTO policies, accrual rules, approval workflows, or automatic application of time off to payroll. Access to time-off data through the API is a related feature, not the policy capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll
